next:wr:384.hint: さらに、彼は正直でもある
next:wr:384.answer: What is more, he is honest too.
next:wr:384.fullSentence: What is more, he is honest too.
next:wr:384.explanation: what is more『さらに』。文頭に置いて情報を追加する。

next:wr:386.hint: 雨やら渋滞やらで、私たちは1時間遅れた
next:wr:386.answer: What with the rain and with the traffic, we were an hour late.
next:wr:386.fullSentence: What with the rain and with the traffic, we were an hour late.
next:wr:386.explanation: what with A and (what with) B『AやらBやらで』。複数の原因が重なることを表す。
next:wr:386.relatedInfo: 理由を列挙して結果を導く慣用表現。

next:wr:388.hint: いわゆる人工知能が私たちの生活を変えつつある
next:wr:388.answer: What is called artificial intelligence is changing our lives.
next:wr:388.fullSentence: What is called artificial intelligence is changing our lives.
next:wr:388.explanation: What is called ~ ＝ what we call ~『いわゆる〜』。

next:wr:390.hint: 最初に来る人は誰でも賞をもらえる
next:wr:390.answer: Whoever comes first will get the prize.
next:wr:390.fullSentence: Whoever comes first will get the prize.
next:wr:390.explanation: whoever ＝ anyone who『〜する人は誰でも』。複合関係代名詞。
next:wr:390.relatedInfo: 先行詞を含む点がwhoと異なる。

next:wr:392.hint: 彼女の歌を聞く人は誰でも癒される
next:wr:392.answer: Whoever hears her song feels relaxed.
next:wr:392.fullSentence: Whoever hears her song feels relaxed.
next:wr:392.explanation: Whoever hears her song feels relaxed.『彼女の歌を聞く人は誰でも癒される』。複合関係代名詞が主語になる例。

next:wr:394.hint: 誰が電話してきても、私は外出中だと伝えて
next:wr:394.answer: Whoever calls, tell them I'm out.
next:wr:394.fullSentence: Whoever calls, tell them I'm out.
next:wr:394.explanation: whoever ＝ no matter who『誰が〜でも』(譲歩)。
next:wr:394.relatedInfo: 文頭でカンマを伴う譲歩節としてよく使われる。

next:wr:396.hint: どこへ行っても、私はあなたについていく
next:wr:396.answer: Wherever you go, I will follow you.
next:wr:396.fullSentence: Wherever you go, I will follow you.
next:wr:396.explanation: wherever ＝ no matter where『どこで〜でも』(譲歩)。

next:wr:398.hint: どんなに頑張っても、みんなを喜ばせることはできない
next:wr:398.answer: However hard you try, you can't please everyone.
next:wr:398.fullSentence: However hard you try, you can't please everyone.
next:wr:398.explanation: however ＝ no matter how『どんなに〜でも』(譲歩)。
next:wr:398.relatedInfo: however+形容詞/副詞+SVの語順に注意。

next:wr:400.hint: 寝るための場所が必要だ
next:wr:400.answer: I need a place in which to sleep.
next:wr:400.fullSentence: I need a place in which to sleep.
next:wr:400.explanation: 前置詞+関係代名詞+to不定詞『〜するための…』の形。
next:wr:400.relatedInfo: a place to sleep in とほぼ同じ意味。

next:wr:403.hint: 私が訪れたいと思っている京都には、多くの世界遺産がある(非限定用法)
next:wr:403.answer: Kyoto, which I would like to visit, has many World heritage sites.
next:wr:403.fullSentence: Kyoto, which I would like to visit, has many World heritage sites.
next:wr:403.explanation: 非限定用法(コンマ+関係詞)で先行詞Kyotoに補足説明を加える。
next:wr:403.relatedInfo: 固有名詞は基本的に非限定用法でしか修飾できない。

next:wr:405.hint: 私には姉妹が3人いて、その全員が海外に住んでいる
next:wr:405.answer: I have three sisters, all of whom live abroad.
next:wr:405.fullSentence: I have three sisters, all of whom live abroad.
next:wr:405.explanation: all of whom『その全員が〜』。非限定用法+of whom(前置詞+関係代名詞)の形。
next:wr:405.relatedInfo: neither of whom『そのどちらも〜ない』も同じ構造。

next:wr:407.hint: 私は風呂に入るように言われ、その助言に従った
next:wr:407.answer: I was told to take a bath, which advice I followed.
next:wr:407.fullSentence: I was told to take a bath, which advice I followed.
next:wr:407.explanation: which+名詞『その〜』。非限定用法で前の内容を受けてwhich+名詞の形をとる特殊な形。
next:wr:407.relatedInfo: which advice = that adviceのような働き。

next:wr:409.hint: 彼についてはいつものことだが、遅刻した
next:wr:409.answer: He was late, as is usual with him.
next:wr:409.fullSentence: He was late, as is usual with him.
next:wr:409.explanation: as is usual (with A)『(Aについては)いつものことだが』。疑似関係代名詞as。
next:wr:409.relatedInfo: as is the case (with A)とほぼ同義。

next:wr:412.hint: 彼女が適任だと思った男を雇った
next:wr:412.answer: She hired a man who she thought was right for the job.
next:wr:412.fullSentence: She hired a man who she thought was right for the job.
next:wr:412.explanation: a man who she thought was right『彼女が正しいと思った男』。she thoughtが関係代名詞節に挿入された形(連鎖関係詞節)。
next:wr:412.relatedInfo: whoの後にshe thoughtが挿入されている。

next:wr:414.hint: 彼が到着したとき、みんな立ち上がった
next:wr:414.answer: When he arrived, everyone stood up.
next:wr:414.fullSentence: When he arrived, everyone stood up.
next:wr:414.explanation: when『〜するとき』。時を表す接続詞。
next:wr:414.relatedInfo: since, before, until, by the time, as soon asなども同じ時を表すグループ。

next:wr:416.hint: 雨が降っていたので、私たちは家にいた
next:wr:416.answer: Since it was raining, we stayed home.
next:wr:416.fullSentence: Since it was raining, we stayed home.
next:wr:416.relatedInfo: sinceは『すでにわかっている理由』を導くことが多い。

next:wr:418.hint: 宿題を終わらせるならば、テレビを見てもいい
next:wr:418.answer: Provided (that) you finish your homework, you can watch TV.
next:wr:418.fullSentence: Provided (that) you finish your homework, you can watch TV.
next:wr:418.relatedInfo: ifよりもやや条件を強調するニュアンス。

next:wr:420.hint: 彼は若いけれども、とても責任感がある
next:wr:420.answer: Although he is young, he is very responsible.
next:wr:420.fullSentence: Although he is young, he is very responsible.
next:wr:420.relatedInfo: thoughとほぼ同義だが、althoughの方がやや堅い表現。

next:wr:422.hint: 彼はお金持ちだけれども、質素な生活をしている(事実への譲歩)
next:wr:422.answer: Even though he is rich, he lives a simple life.
next:wr:422.fullSentence: Even though he is rich, he lives a simple life.
next:wr:422.explanation: even though『たとえ〜でも』。事実として成立していることへの譲歩。
next:wr:422.relatedInfo: even if(仮定)との違いに注意。

next:wr:425.hint: 家に歩いて帰っている間に、雨が降り始めた(時)
next:wr:425.answer: As I was walking home, it started to rain.
next:wr:425.fullSentence: As I was walking home, it started to rain.

next:wr:427.hint: 遅かったので、私たちは家に帰ることにした(理由)
next:wr:427.answer: As it was late, we decided to go home.
next:wr:427.fullSentence: As it was late, we decided to go home.
next:wr:427.relatedInfo: becauseよりも軽い理由を表すことが多い。

next:wr:429.hint: 暗かったけれども、私たちは道を見つけた(譲歩の倒置)
next:wr:429.answer: Dark as it was, we found the way.
next:wr:429.fullSentence: Dark as it was, we found the way.
next:wr:429.explanation: 形容詞+as+S+V『〜だけれども』(譲歩の倒置構文)。asは譲歩の意味。
next:wr:429.relatedInfo: Although it was dark, ~ と同義。

next:wr:431.hint: 彼は良い父親だが、(実際は)悪い夫だ
next:wr:431.answer: He is a good father, though he is a poor husband.
next:wr:431.fullSentence: He is a good father, though he is a poor husband.
next:wr:431.explanation: A is B, though『Aは(実際は)〜だけれど』。thoughを文末近くに置いて対比を加える口語的用法。
next:wr:431.relatedInfo: 文末のthoughは『でも』のような軽い接続を表す。

next:wr:433.hint: 好きなようにやっていいですよ
next:wr:433.answer: You can do it as you please.
next:wr:433.fullSentence: You can do it as you please.
next:wr:433.explanation: as you please『好きなように』。
next:wr:433.relatedInfo: 様態を表すasの慣用表現。

next:wr:435.hint: 疲れていたので、早く寝た(等位接続詞so)
next:wr:435.answer: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
next:wr:435.fullSentence: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
next:wr:435.explanation: 等位接続詞so『だから』。理由と結果をつなぐ。
next:wr:435.relatedInfo: and, but, or, for, nor, yetも等位接続詞のグループ。
